summary: Frontend-only test of Home feed favorite-categories ordering + preselection. Full happy path passed: fresh anonymous signup -> onboarding (selected SPORT then GOSSIP in that exact order, age 27, sex M, region Lombardia) -> home. Chip row order (testID category-chip-row) is exactly [chip-all, chip-sport, chip-gossip, chip-politica, chip-tv, chip-musica, chip-cinema, chip-social]. Active chip is chip-sport (background rgb(255,230,0) = brandSecondary yellow) while all others use inactive dark bg rgb(15,15,15). Feed initially shows only 2 SPORT feuds (both cards start with 'SPORT' category label). Clicking chip-all switches active state and loads 20 mixed-category feuds (CINEMA/GOSSIP/SOCIAL/MUSICA/POLITICA/etc.), confirming the reorder does not break normal filtering. Regression 'no favorites -> Tutte active + all feuds' cannot be reproduced via UI or backend (both enforce >=1 favorite at onboarding); verified defensively by code inspection at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx L50-52 where empty favs falls back to initial='all'. No console errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx L37-52: Correctly builds ordered chip list [ALL_CAT, ...favs in user-picked order, ...remaining categories not in favs]. Uses Set for O(1) dedup and preserves categories.find() order for favorites so the exact user selection order is respected.
index.tsx L51: Guards against a favorite id that no longer exists in the categories list via `c.categories.some(x => x.id === favs[0])` before preselecting -- safe against stale favorites.
index.tsx useEffect depends on `user?.favorite_categories` -- if the user profile is later updated (e.g., from onboarding re-entry) the chip row and initial category will re-derive correctly.

onboarding.tsx submits Array.from(selected) where selected is a Set -- Set preserves insertion order in JS, so tapping SPORT then GOSSIP sends favorite_categories=['sport','gossip'] in that order to the backend, which is exactly what the feature expects.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 UI expectations met + regression path verified via code)

seed_data_creation: One anonymous user created via UI (nickname TESTfav<timestamp>). No cleanup needed -- disposable anonymous data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home feed chip row testIDs are 'category-chip-row' (row) and 'chip-{id}' where id is one of {all, politica, tv, musica, sport, cinema, social, gossip}. Active chip is detected via background color: brandSecondary rgb(255,230,0) = active, surfaceInverse rgb(15,15,15) = inactive. Feud cards use testID='feud-card-{feud_id}' and their first text node is the uppercase category label -- useful to assert filter output. Onboarding categories preserve insertion order because they are stored in a JS Set; ordering guarantee holds as long as this stays a Set.
